info.name: Customer Churn Prediction API
info.description:
Requests to test the Customer Churn FastAPI service (health, schema, predict).

Base URL defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8000

body.raw:
{
  "features": {
    "Age": 30,
    "Gender": "Female",
    "Tenure": 39,
    "Usage Frequency": 14,
    "Support Calls": 5,
    "Payment Delay": 18,
    "Subscription Type": "Standard",
    "Contract Length": "Annual",
    "Total Spend": 932,
    "Last Interaction": 17
  }
}

request.description:
Send raw (unprocessed) feature values. Keys should match the preprocessor input columns. Use GET /schema to confirm required_columns.

Expected response fields:
- prediction: 0/1
- probability: optional
- model_path: which model.pkl was loaded
